items.html:
Henk has got all the timing and grace of a lefthander. Has spend a few
winters in South Africa and knows the conditions well. During this World Cup
Henk should be able to mature and establish himself as a top order batsman.
Bowls a bit like Wasim Akram and could be used for a few overs in the middle
of the innings. Very quick fielder in the inner circle.
